document:
Exercise: Hip Flexion with Band

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_hip_flexion

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- bands

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- quadriceps_strength_and_hypertrophy

Contraindications:

- Recent knee surgery
- Severe hip pain or injury

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:

- name: Bodyweight Squats, equipment: none
- name: Leg Press, equipment: leg press machine

Instructions:

- Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle.
- Face away from the attachment point of the band.
- Keeping your head and your chest up, raise your knee up to 90 degrees and pause.
- Return the leg to the starting position.
